articles.title: Why Bitcoin's BIP-110 refuses to die despite near-zero miner support
articles.snippet: BIP-110 has attracted only a sliver of miner support, yet its user-activated design means the proposal continues toward its activation date and (most likely) beyond.

articles.title: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The latest bipartisan ethics proposal would reportedly require Trump to divest crypto businesses while allowing him to defer capital gains taxes on those sales.

articles.title: US Senate will vote on CLARITY crypto bill ‘without any question’ this week: Tim Scott
articles.snippet: The South Carolina lawmaker who heads the Senate Banking Committee said that the majority leader still had time to put the crypto bill on the agenda despite the narrow voting window.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot loses Wall Street’s wow factor
articles.snippet: New analysis finds AI infrastructure contracts are becoming larger and more profitable, but investors now demand stronger execution before rewarding bitcoin mining stocks.

articles.title: China’s Kimi K3 Broke Out of Its Sandbox to Look Up Test Answers
articles.snippet: Unlike the recent breakouts at OpenAI and Anthropic, this involved a model anyone can download, running its default safeguards.
